actions.reason: K2_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (broad oxidative-phosphorylation/mitochondrial program with immune and proliferative signatures; ER:0155eb9d7205:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e9f462ede3), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence bearing directly on the current boundary is weak and unsupportive: the pair boundary silhouette is essentially zero (0.0003) and between-set fused affinity (0.00902) is essentially equal to within-set affinity (0.00932), so the boundary is not expressed as a distinct separation (ER:0155eb9d7205:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:fbf65f89cc); native-geometry alignment likewise shows near-zero to small silhouettes (CT 0.013, WSI 0.050, RNA 0.079, WXS 0.091) with within-label distance only marginally below between-label distance in every modality (ER:0155eb9d7205:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:fbf65f89cc, ER:0155eb9d7205:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e9f462ede3). No supported internal subdivision exists (screen k=1), and merge is not a legal structural action here, so no structural revision can repair the unsupported boundary. With decision-relevant membership evidence exhausted and independence not positively justified, K2_C0001 is not retained as an independent unit in this run.
